# Research templates

[Contribution guide](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Research workflow](../contributing/research.md)

| Template | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [Proposal](proposal.md) | A new question, null, baseline, data contract and evaluation plan. |
| [Result or replication](result.md) | Executed result, discrepancy, negative outcome or named blocker. |
| [Research issue](../../.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/01-research-proposal.md) | Public discussion before a material experiment. |
| [Replication issue](../../.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/02-replication-result.md) | A reproducibility attempt or failed result. |
| [Data/engineering issue](../../.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/03-data-engineering.md) | A concrete defect with a minimal example. |
| [PR checklist](../../.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) | Evidence, testing and privacy review for every contribution. |

Copy a document template into a new descriptively named report under `docs/research/`.
Do not edit the template to store your result. For strategy lifecycle records, use
the existing schema under `data/strategies/` instead of creating a second registry.
These templates require facts, not fabricated values: write "not available" and
explain the consequence when evidence is missing.
